description: This is a Python source file defining a FastAPI router for an 'Economy' API module. It includes multiple command endpoints for retrieving various economic data and reports using asynchronous functions and external services. The file also dynamically includes other routers and provides an endpoint for downloading FOMC documents.

methods.name: OBBject calendar( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get the upcoming, or historical, economic calendar of global events.

methods.name: OBBject cpi( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get Consumer Price Index (CPI). Returns either the rescaled index value, or a rate of change (inflation).

methods.name: OBBject risk_premium( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get Market Risk Premium by country.

methods.name: OBBject balance_of_payments( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Balance of Payments Reports.

methods.name: OBBject fred_search( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Search for FRED series or economic releases by ID or string.

methods.name: OBBject fred_series( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get data by series ID from FRED.

methods.name: OBBject fred_release_table( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get economic release data by ID and/or element from FRED.

methods.name: OBBject money_measures( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get Money Measures (M1/M2 and components).

methods.name: OBBject unemployment( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get global unemployment data.

methods.name: OBBject composite_leading_indicator( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get the composite leading indicator (CLI). It provides early signals of business cycle turning points.

methods.name: OBBject fred_regional( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Query the Geo Fred API for regional economic data by series group.

methods.name: OBBject country_profile( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get a profile of country statistics and economic indicators.

methods.name: OBBject available_indicators( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get the available economic indicators for a provider.

methods.name: OBBject indicators( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get economic indicators by country and indicator.

methods.name: OBBject central_bank_holdings( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get the balance sheet holdings of a central bank.

methods.name: OBBject share_price_index( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get the Share Price Index by country from the OECD.

methods.name: OBBject house_price_index( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get the House Price Index by country from the OECD.

methods.name: OBBject interest_rates( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get interest rates by country(s) and duration.

methods.name: OBBject retail_prices( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get retail prices for common items.

methods.name: OBBject primary_dealer_positioning( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get Primary dealer positioning statistics.

methods.name: OBBject pce( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) reports.

methods.name: OBBject export_destinations( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get top export destinations by country from the UN Comtrade Database.

methods.name: OBBject primary_dealer_fails( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get Primary Dealer Fails to Deliver and Receive.

methods.name: OBBject direction_of_trade( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get Direction Of Trade Statistics from the IMF database.

methods.name: OBBject fomc_documents( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get FOMC documents by year and document type.

methods.name: list fomc_documents_download(params: Annotated[dict, Body()])
methods.description: Download FOMC documents from the Federal Reserve's website.
